# World Composting

## Overview
World Composting is a comprehensive resource for composting education, featuring guides, checklists, video playlists, gear recommendations, and blog posts covering worm composting, hot composting, bokashi, biochar, and sustainable living.

## Site Structure

### Pillar Guides
- [Worm Composting](https://www.worldcomposting.com/worm-composting.html) — Complete vermicomposting guide
- [Hot Composting](https://www.worldcomposting.com/hot-composting.html) — Thermophilic decomposition guide
- [The Science of Compost](https://www.worldcomposting.com/science-of-compost.html) — Microbiology and chemistry
